How old are you?
CloakRun is played outdoors with real people. We ask so we can keep it suitable for you. Only the age range is kept, on this phone.
Under 13
18 or older
CloakRun is for players aged 13 and over
Thanks for wanting to play. This game uses live location outdoors, so it is only available from age 13.
Stay safe
These rules apply to every match. The game will remind you, but you are in charge of your own safety.
Never trespass. Stay in public places, and respect fences and signs.
Stay off roads, rail lines and water. Never cross traffic to escape.
Play in groups, and avoid isolated or unlit places.
Daytime is best. Tell someone where you are playing.
If anything feels unsafe, stop. The SOS button ends the match for everyone.
Under 18: play with a parent or guardian\'s permission, and with an adult nearby.
I will play safe
Who sees what
Your exact location never leaves your phone.
During a match, other players see a fuzzy zone around you, never a dot. It shrinks as the match goes on.
Location is used only during a match you joined, with a notification showing the whole time.
Your name and avatar are visible to players in your lobby.
Match data is deleted when the match ends. You can delete your account and data at any time in your profile.
Share crash reports and anonymous usage statistics
Helps fix bugs. Never includes your location. You can change this later.
